diagram_math_checks.justification: Local Definition requires symmetric positive-definite B. For the displayed B, (u,v)B(u,v)^T=(u-v)^2+v^2>0 for (u,v) nonzero; Delta=3/2>0 and g nonzero.
alg-trust-region-cauchy-step Definition gives g^TBg=1, ||g||=1 and tau=min(1,3/2)=1. Hence p_C=-g=(1,0); its norm 1<3/2. The O-to-C segment follows -g.
The displayed B times (2,1)^T equals (1,0)^T=-g. Thus p_N=(2,1), with norm sqrt(5)>3/2, so local steps 1 and 2 do not return.

Local step 3 gives d=(1,1), a=2, b=2, c=-5/4; its positive root is (sqrt(14)-2)/4 in (0,1). Hence p_D=(1+t,t), ||p_D||=3/2. TikZ coordinates use a common factor two (O=(0,0), C=(2,0), N=(4,2), circle radius 3); D=(2.870829,0.870829) approximates 2p_D to below 1e-6. C,D,N are collinear in that order.

Along p_C+s d the boundary polynomial is 2s^2+2s-5/4, increasing for s>=0. It is positive after t, so the dashed D-to-N continuation is exterior. The caption retains local step 4 comparing m(p_D),m(p_C) rather than implying every input returns p_D; for this concrete model m(p_D)-m(p_C)=-t+t^2/2<0.

The diagram concerns vectors in R^2 and the Euclidean trust-region ball from def-trust-region-quadratic-model-and-ratio; no new maps, commutativities, dependencies, or claims for all models are introduced. The original Definition is unchanged. lem-positive-definite-model-has-unique-newton-step steps 2.1 and 3.1 establish the branch interfaces and unique intersection independently of the figure.
